_comment: Leads only (Team Norway package D, 2026-10-07). EVERY entry is rights-unverified and withheld: nothing is downloaded or bundled. Evidence records are from research report docs/norway/recon/corpus-rights-bible.md and were not checked by a person or a lawyer. Entries with "lang": "nn" are Nynorsk works kept in this Bokmål course manifest (the course reads nn as a companion language); the library builder needs a decision on where they are built.

entries.title: Bibelen (Det Norske Bibelselskap, 1930)
entries.author: Det Norske Bibelselskap (translation committee)

rights.basis: Bibelselskapet says on its own page that the 1930 Bokmål translation has "falt i det fri"; it names no legal basis. The CrossWire SWORD module Norsk labels it Public Domain, which is CrossWire's statement, not Bibelselskapet's. The death years of the 1930 translators are unchecked and the 2020 notes and cross-references of the module have an unstated author. A lead for verification, not a conclusion. Norwegian term: åndsverkloven § 11, life of the author plus 70 years (recon 3, digest of lovdata.no). A translation or a modern edition is its own protected work (§ 6).
rights.acquisitionNotes: Rights not verified. Nothing is bundled until a person records the exact edition, its source and the legal basis with their evidence.

evidenceRecords.note: Bibelselskapet lists the 1930 Bokmål and 1938 Nynorsk translations (and Bibal 1895, North Sami) as free to use without permission. No date on the page; no legal basis given; protected: Bibel 2011, NO78/85, NO78, NT 2005, Biibbal 2019. Bibel 2024 is not named (inferred protected).

CrossWire module Norsk, version 2.0 (2020-02-08), OSIS XML, 1.82 MB, Lang=nb; text scanned and proofed by H. Priebe and co-workers, based on the version prepared by Tore Vamraak; TextSource http://unbound.biola.edu/. Completeness and error rate not documented.
Åpen Bibel README says the copyright of the 1930 base text has expired; contributors waive their rights under CC0; no licence file; baseline provenance undocumented.

entries.withheldReason: rights unverified: Bibelselskapet's "falt i det fri" statement gives no legal basis and the translators' death years are unchecked; the module also needs the owner's download approval (about 1.82 MB). Only the three-verse seed excerpt data/corpus/nb/bible-1john-1.json exists, and it is held out of the release bundle.
entries.notes: A full Bible needs the owner's download approval for SWORD module Norsk and its own builder. The 1930 text is the Bokmål of the 1917 reform (Riksmål era): "forat", "gav", hard consonants, ei/en forms.

entries.title: Studentmållagsbibelen (1921)
entries.author: Studentmållaget (Peter Hognestad, main editor)

rights.basis: The CrossWire SWORD module NorSMB labels the 1921 Studentmållag translation Public Domain. This is the 1921 Landsmål text, NOT the 1938 Nynorsk Bible; the 1938 reviser (Ragnvald Indrebø) died in 1984, so Bibelselskapet's "falt i det fri" statement for 1938 is in tension with life plus 70 years. No digital 1938 text with a licence statement was found. The 1921 contributors' death years are unchecked. A lead for verification, not a conclusion. Norwegian term: åndsverkloven § 11, life of the author plus 70 years (recon 3, digest of lovdata.no). A translation or a modern edition is its own protected work (§ 6).
rights.acquisitionNotes: Rights not verified. Nothing is bundled until a person records the exact edition, its source and the legal basis with their evidence.

evidenceRecords.note: CrossWire module NorSMB, version 1.0 (2012-01-25), Lang=nn, 1.72 MB; TextSource http://gamal.nynorsk.no/mu/smio/bibelen/ (host no longer resolves).
Bibelselskapet says the 1938 Nynorsk translation has fallen into the public domain; this concerns 1938, not the 1921 translation, and gives no legal basis.
Ragnvald Indrebø (born 1891), sole reviser of the 1938 Nynorsk Bible, died 26 June 1984 (SNL / Wikipedia digests): under life plus 70 years the 1938 revision would run to the end of 2054.

entries.withheldReason: rights unverified: contributors' death years unchecked; the 1938 text has no digital source with a licence; the module needs the owner's download approval (about 1.72 MB). Only the three-verse seed excerpt data/corpus/nn/bible-1john-1.json exists, held out of the release bundle.
entries.notes: Nynorsk work, read receptively and counted in its own (nn) accounts. The language is 1921 Landsmål (hev, me, so, sanningi), not the 2012 norm.

Norwegian term: åndsverkloven § 11, life of the author plus 70 years (recon 3, digest of lovdata.no). A translation or a modern edition is its own protected work (§ 6).

rights.basis: Asbjørnsen died in 1885, Moe in 1882. The Wikikilden (Norwegian Wikisource) 1852 text is the lead.
